purpose: Reopen the search space and identify markets where branded trend commentary, owned-state utility and permissioned personalization can form a durable loop.

candidate_domains.thesis: High trend velocity and visual shareability; owned value must move beyond reviews into preference history, product compatibility, routines and decision memory.
Strong repeat intent and accumulated progress state create a return path from entertainment into owned utility.
Trend commentary can acquire attention while streaks, skill state, spaced practice and outcome history create first-party compounding value.
Highly visual and trend-driven; owned service can preserve trip intent, constraints, comparisons and itinerary state.
Character-led testing and criticism can attract users; owned gear history, skill progress and project state may create durable utility.
Strong visual sharing and repeat need, but social recipe import and meal-planning utility are increasingly crowded.
main_risks: weak differentiation if limited to import/save

candidate_domains.thesis: Strong monetization and recurring intent but user-harm and regulatory exposure make aggressive trend-commentary funnels unsuitable as an early clean-growth target.
High attention and purchase value but health, body-image and medical decision risks dominate the clean-growth opportunity score.

data_boundary.rule: Do not rely on covert cross-app or browser-history surveillance. Use contextual signals, consented first-party state, and separately permissioned data where lawful and necessary.
data_boundary.reason: Platform policy and durable trust are treated as design constraints rather than obstacles to evade.

fresh_policy_evidence.observed_2026_09_11: Personal/sensitive data collection and unexpected background use require transparent in-app disclosure and, where required, affirmative consent; collection should be limited to necessary purposes.
